description: List the currencies a given currency can be exchanged to on SimpleSwap, for floating (default) or fixed rate. Identify the source by ticker and network (e.g. btc/btc); if the network is unknown, find it with simpleswap_list_currencies first. Use query to check one target currency. Page with offset/limit: each response is cut at about 20 000 characters regardless of limit, so when truncated is true, call again with offset=nextOffset.

fixed.description: true for fixed-rate, false for floating-rate (default).

limit.description: Upper bound on items to return. The response is also cut by size, so fewer may come back: check truncated and continue with nextOffset.

offset.description: Index of the first item to return. Default 0.

query.description: Case-insensitive filter of the targets by ticker or network, e.g. "usdt" or "trx".

name: simpleswap_list_pairs

to.description: Currencies the source currency can be exchanged to.

truncated.description: true when more items exist; continue with nextOffset.

title: List pairs
